name: Alight Inc
summary:
Alight (ALIT) reported earnings of $0.73 per share on revenue of $511.00 million for the second quarter ended June 2026. The consensus earnings estimate was $0.52 per share on revenue of $494.90 million. The company beat consensus estimates by 40.38% while revenue fell 3.22% compared to the same quarter a year ago.

The company said it expects third quarter revenue of $469.0 million to $479.0 million and 2026 revenue of $2.078 billion to $2.098 billion. The current consensus revenue estimate is $496.83 million for the quarter ending September 30, 2026 and revenue of $2.12 billion for the year ending December 31, 2026.

Alight is a leading cloud-based human capital technology and services provider that powers confident health, wealth and wellbeing decisions for 36 million people and dependents.
subject: Alight Beat Consensus Estimates
